Cases in state totals that no county accounts for

Source: R/no_county_cases.R
no_county_cases.Rd

A state's total in CDC AtlasPlus is usually larger than the sum of its counties. no_county_cases() compares each state total with the county counts supplied. Run it after impute_suppressed() for the remainder that no county accounts for; on county data straight from get_atlas() it reports only the gap left by published counts.

For CDC's HIV estimates (get_atlas("estimate")), county data cover only the Ending the HIV Epidemic (EHE) counties, so the remainder can include people in counties outside EHE coverage and isn't necessarily cases with no county; a message says so.

The remainder is a difference, not a count of identified cases. One likely explanation is cases whose county of residence is unknown or not released, but CDC's documentation doesn't say so; it also includes any counties left out of x. In 2022 the gap was far larger than suppressed counties could hold at 1-4 cases each, so it can't be used to fill them in. extrapolate_from_county() leaves the remainder out by default; no_county = "spread" shares it across the state's counties instead. See the "About CDC AtlasPlus data" article.

Usage

no_county_cases(x)

Arguments

x

County data from get_atlas(geography = "county"), usually after impute_suppressed().

Value

A tibble with one row per state, indicator, year and stratum:

state_fips, state

State FIPS code and name.

indicator, year, race_ethnicity, sex, age

As in x.

state_cases

The state total published by CDC.

published_cases

Sum of the published county counts in x.

unpublished_cases

state_cases - published_cases: cases in suppressed counties together with the remainder no county accounts for.

imputed_cases

Sum of the counts impute_suppressed() filled in; NA if x hasn't been imputed.

no_county_cases

unpublished_cases - imputed_cases. Can be negative if the imputed counts are too high, and is NA if x hasn't been imputed.

Every column computed from state_cases is NA if CDC suppressed the state total.

Details

Downloads the state data matching x (same diseases, years and stratification) from CDC AtlasPlus. The remainder also includes any county without a count in x: "Data not available" rows, counties removed by filtering x, and suppressed rows impute_suppressed() couldn't estimate (marked cases_source = "not estimated"), which count as 0 imputed cases. The report has a row only for state groups (state, indicator, year and stratum) with at least one row in x: if impute_suppressed(not_available = "drop") or filtering removed every row of a group, its state total is not reported.

See also

impute_suppressed(), extrapolate_from_county(); the article "About CDC AtlasPlus data" on why state totals and county counts differ.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
county <- get_atlas("hiv", "county", 2022)
county <- impute_suppressed(county)
no_county_cases(county)
} # }
